did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The restaurant added a base (Classic burger, 200) and the ingredients Beef patty (80) and Bacon (30) on its Custom food page. A signed-in shop buyer opened the restaurant, built a burger with both ingredients, named it "My double bacon burger" and saved it as a favourite. The page was reloaded and the favourite was added with one tap.

checks.text: The restaurant page has "Build your own": choose a base, tick ingredients, and the price follows (Classic burger + 2 / 10 · 310.00)
"Name this favourite" and "Save as a favourite" keep it: "Your favourites: My double bacon burger 310.00" with Add and Remove, still there after the page is loaded again
One tap on Add puts "1 × Classic burger (your own), Beef patty, Bacon, 310.00" into the order

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The base and the ingredient prices were set by the restaurant first, because the demo restaurant had none.

shots.caption: The buyer builds a burger; the price follows the choices
One tap on Add: the favourite is in the order
